faq.title: FAQ
faq.faq1Content: 9M AI is a New York–based AI fintech company founded by former Goldman Sachs executives, Columbia University AI scientists, and top quantitative engineers. It delivers fully automated investment and asset-management solutions using proprietary AI trading models.
faq.faq2Content: To reshape the connection between people and capital through AI, enabling every user to have a 24/7, ever-evolving AI wealth partner.
faq.faq3Content: Its proprietary NovaMind™ AI decision engine integrates market sensing, strategy execution, risk control, and optimization into a closed-loop process for intelligent investing.
faq.faq4: What are 9M AI’s core competitive advantages?
faq.faq4Content: As a global AI fintech company, 9M AI relies on a proprietary technology framework and unique algorithmic models—integrating market sensing, strategy execution, risk control, and optimization—to create differentiated performance in live trading.
faq.faq5Content:
Two main fund types:
AI Strategy Funds – Stake USDT + major coins to earn USDM
AI Stable Funds – Stake USDT + USDM to earn 9MC
Both offer cycles from short-term to 360 days with principal redemption at maturity.

uCardIntro1: The U Card is a convenient and secure payment tool available in both virtual and physical formats. Users can link it to their digital wallet or bank account, making payments online on global e-commerce platforms and app stores, as well as using the physical card for POS purchases and ATM withdrawals.
uCardIntro2: Virtual cards generate a card number instantly upon application, making them ideal for quick use and subscription payments. Physical cards are delivered like traditional bank cards, offering long-term validity and meeting everyday offline needs. Whether it's cross-border shopping, digital subscriptions, or everyday payments, the U Card provides users with a flexible and secure solution.
